# Spain

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 100% | 99% | 100% | 0% |

Spain's national and regional statute law is close to fully covered: spain-law holds 8,774 of the 8,839 state-level norms in the BOE's consolidated legislation, with in-force history, and the 17 regional repositories hold about 99% of the 3,623 regional norms the BOE consolidates. All essentials are present and current to October 2026, and three spot checks against the BOE match. But the record ends 2026-10-28, regional regulations are not covered, Ceuta and Melilla hold only their statutes, and there is no case law.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
